Commentary.Commentary: We are set for the chase to get underway! The players of Netherlands make their way out to the middle. Stephan Baard and Zane Green are the opening batters for Namibia. Fred Klaassen to start with the ball.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Netherlands’ batters will feel they have done their job and now it is onto their bowlers. They do have a good bowling attack and will fancy themselves to defend this. Namibia will have to bat out of their skins to chase this down. All to play for in the second half. Stay tuned.

Colin Ackermann is up for a chat. He says that it is a pretty good score. Credits Max O'Dowd by saying that he batted really well and is the anchor of the side and others bat around him. Tells that Namibia bowled well and made things difficult for them.

The bowlers of Namibia weren’t that bad either. The Netherlands’ batters just played quite sensibly. Namibia did bowl the right lengths and there were not many bad balls. One could probably say they were a little too predictable with their slower ones, especially Jan Frylinck who is quite reliable but did not have the best of days despite taking a couple of wickets. David Wiese was the only other to get into the wicket’s column.

Max O'Dowd was the mainstay for Netherlands! He played the anchor role and the others played around him. His stand of 82 with Colin Ackermann was very crucial. That laid the platform and Scott Edwards added the finishing touch at the end. They paced the innings quite well and despite losing two quick wickets in the middle overs, did not let things dry up.

A really good show with the bat by the Dutch has taken them to a score which can be considered just above par here. At one stage they did look like getting around the 170-run mark but they will be still pleased with the effort today.
Two to end the innings! Length ball, on the pads. Logan van Beek whips it wide of deep square leg for a couple. Netherlands end at 164 for 4!
Short ball, on leg. Scott Edwards misses the pull and they get a bye.
FOUR! Great execution! Shorter ball, on off. Scott Edwards reverse scoops it over the keeper for a boundary!
Logan van Beek is the new man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Max O'Dowd falls! Full ball, on the pads. Pushed to long on. They look for the second but Max O'Dowd has run out of gas. The fielder, Gerhard Erasmus, throws the ball to David Wiese and he runs Max O'Dowd out by a mile.
Full ball, on the pads. Edwards flicks it towards deep square leg. A fumble allows the second.
FOUR! Top shot! On a length, outside off. Scott Edwards creams it through covers for a boundary.
David Wiese (3-0-19-1) comes back to bowl the last over.

TWO LEG BYES! Throw at the wrong end! Length ball, on off. Max O'Dowd looks to sweep but gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls away and they run across. They run to take the second. The keeper collects it but throws the ball at his end, but misses. Had he thrown to the other end, it would have been a run out. A good comeback by the bowler. Despite the six, just 10 came from the over.
Well bowled again! Slower ball, on a length, on off. Max O'Dowd comes down the track to hit it but misses.
Really well bowled. A full one, wide outside off. Scott Edwards hits it to deep cover for one.
Dot again! Full ball, outside off. Edwards gets no bat on it.
SIX! Just enough to clear the ropes! Length ball, on off. Scott Edwards slog-sweeps it in the air. The man at deep mid-wicket leaps up to take it. The ball hits his hands and goes over the ropes.
Full ball, outside off. Edwards misses the drive.
Full ball, slower in pace and down the leg side. Edwards misses the flick. Wide called.
Ruben Trumpelmann (3-0-24-0) comes back to bowl.
Short ball, down the leg side. Scott Edwards pulls it to fine leg for one.
Length ball, on off. Scott Edwards taps it past mid-wicket for a couple.
Scott Edwards walks out to bat.
OUT! TAKEN! Colin Ackermann falls now! Short ball, on off. He pulls it straight to the man at deep mid-wicket. Gerhard Erasmus there, takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Gerhard Erasmus b Jan Frylinck

Commentary.Commentary: A yorker, on the pads. Clipped to deep mid-wicket for one.
Short ball, down the leg side. Colin Ackermann misses the flick. Wide called.
SIX! Well struck! Full ball, on leg. Colin Ackermann flicks it nicely. There is a man at deep square leg, but he watches the ball sail over him.
Full ball, on off. Max O'Dowd heaves it to long on for one.
Length ball, outside off. Colin Ackermann chases it but gets no bat on it.
A low full toss, wide outside off. Max O'Dowd hits it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Full ball, outside off. Pushed past cover for one.
DROPPED! A full toss, on leg. Max O'Dowd goes for the flick but gets the leading edge. The ball goes towards cover. The fielder runs in late and dives but drops it. A single is taken.
A wide yorker, outside off. Pushed past point for one.
Full ball, on off. Colin Ackermann hits it wide of sweeper cover for a couple.
JJ Smit is back on.
Yorker, on off. Colin Ackermann pushes it past covers for one.
Full ball, on off. Pushed to cover for one.
Just past the keeper! Slower bouncer, outside off. Colin Ackermann shuffles across to pull but gets some glove on it. The keeper dives to his right but the ball goes past him and a single is taken.
Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Colin Ackermann gets no bat on it.

Good effort in the field! Length ball, on off. Max O'Dowd hits it wide of long off. The fielder gets to his right and dives but the ball lands short of him. He stops the ball and saves three runs for his side.
Shorter ball, outside off. Pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! Punished by Max O'Dowd! Just what Netherlands need at this stage of the game! Trumpelmann hurls a juicy full toss, on middle and leg. Max O'Dowd moves across and whips it to the vacant deep square leg region to collect a boundary.
Good change of pace from Trumpelmann! A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Max O'Dowd looks to slog hard but he misses.
A yorker-length delivery, outside off. Colin Ackermann squeezes it out towards long off and collects a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Max O'Dowd punches it to extra cover for a run.
Wide! Trumpelmann spills this one way down leg. Max O'Dowd shuffles across looks to scoop but he misses. Wided!
In the air...but safe! Full ball, well outside off. Colin Ackermann slices it to deep backward point, on the bounce. A single taken!
Full ball, outside off. Max O'Dowd drags it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Change. Ruben Trumpelmann (2-0-15-0) is back on.
Flatter ball, around off. Max O'Dowd punches it to long off to collect a single.
FOUR! BANG! A half-tracker, around off. Max O'Dowd pulls it past long on and collects a boundary.
Quicker ball, outside off. Colin Ackermann drags it to long off for a run.
Flatter ball, down leg. Max O'Dowd tucks it to the leg side for one.
FOUR! SHOT! Tossed up, around off. Max O'Dowd makes room on the off side and carves it over cover for a boundary. Max O'Dowd brings up his fifty with that glorious shot!
TWO WIDES! Fuller ball, down leg. Colin Ackermann misses his sweep. The keeper fumbles and the batters cross for one.
Flatter ball, outside off. Max O'Dowd flat-bats it past the bowler and takes one.
Back of a length, outside off. Max O'Dowd punches it on the up towards long off. A single to end the over!
Length ball, around middle and leg. Colin Ackermann works it to the leg side for a run.
Wide! Short and way outside off. Colin Ackermann misses his cut. Wide called!

Good-length ball, way outside off. Max O'Dowd cuts it to extra cover and scampers through for a single. The fielder at cover has a shy at the bowler's end but he fails to hit the stumps and Max O'Dowd survives.
This is a full-length ball, outside off. Colin Ackermann digs it out to cover for one.
Back of a length, outside off. Max O'Dowd pulls it to mid-wicket and collects a run.
Full ball, outside off. Colin Ackermann reaches out and drags it to deep square leg for one.
Change. JJ Smit (2-0-15-0) is back on.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Colin Ackermann hits it to wide of long on for a single.
FOUR! SMASHED! Short and wide. Colin Ackermann stays back and cuts it hard past point for a boundary.
Full ball, on middle. Max O'Dowd drills it to long on for a run.
FOUR! Top shot! Good-length ball, around middle and leg. Max O'Dowd hangs back and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Back of a length, down leg. Colin Ackermann whips it towards deep square leg and takes one.
Leg bye! Good-length ball, angling in from middle. Max O'Dowd misses his flick and gets hit on the pad. The ball rolls away and the batters cross for a leg bye!
Change. Jan Frylinck (2-0-12-1) is back on.
Length ball, darted on the pads. Max O'Dowd flicks it to deep square leg for a single. Just 5 runs off the over!
Swing and a miss! Good-length ball, outside off. Max O'Dowd looks to heave it away but misses.
Back of a length, outside off. Colin Ackermann cuts hard. The fielder at backward point dives to his right and half-stops it. The batters take a run.
Full ball, outside off. Colin Ackermann drags it back to the bowler.

Length ball, outside off. Max O'Dowd pushes it to mid off and takes off for a quick run. The fielder at mid off collects the ball cleanly but misses his shy at the non-striker's end. Had he hit, Max O'Dowd would have been out.
Good-length ball, outside off. Max O'Dowd punches it to deep cover for a couple.

Drinks break! Netherlands have got off to a decent start, courtesy of some fine batting by Max O'Dowd. Netherlands would hope that their set batter bats deep and takes them to a good total. Ruben Trumpelmann is back on.
Full ball, on the pads. Max O'Dowd misses the flick and gets hit on the pads. The batters take a leg bye as the ball rolls away.
Full ball, on off. Colin Ackermann hits it to mid off for one.
Length ball, on off. Pulled to deep square leg for one.
Shorter ball, on off. Max O'Dowd hits it wide of long on for a couple.
Back of a length, outside off. Cut away to deep cover for one.
On a length, outside off. Max O'Dowd hits it to deep point for one.
JJ Smit comes back into the attack.
Full ball, on the pads. Max O'Dowd flicks it to deep square leg for one.
Just a single as this is hit down to long off.
Darted on the pads. Blocked out.
Colin Ackermann backs away to the leg side so Bernard Scholtz follows him with a quicker one. Blocked out.
Loopy ball, on off. Hit down to long on for one.
Tossed up, on off. Colin Ackermann comes down the track and clips it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Full ball, on off. Colin Ackermann whips it to long on for one.
Shorter ball, outside off. Colin Ackermann gets no bat on it.
On a length, on off. Blocked out.
Shorter ball, outside off. Cut away to deep point for a couple.
Colin Ackermann is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! David Wiese comes back and gets the big wicket! Short ball, outside off. Roelof van der Merwe goes for the cut but gets the outside edge. The ball flies to third man and Bernard Scholtz takes it with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Bernard Scholtz b David Wiese

Commentary.Commentary: Full ball, on the pads. Max O'Dowd flicks it to deep square leg for one.
David Wiese (1-0-10-0) is back on.
FOUR! Nicely executed! Tossed up, on leg. Roelof van der Merwe reverse-sweeps it to thr third man fence. Quality stroke.
Flatter ball, around off. Max O'Dowd hits it to long off for one.
Shorter ball, on middle. Roelof van der Merwe backs away and hits it to deep cover for one.
Loopy ball, on leg. Hit down to long on for one.
Darted on the pads. Roelof van der Merwe works it past square leg for one.
Flatter ball, on off. Cut away past covers for one.
Bernard Scholtz comes back to bowl.
Full ball, on the pads. Max O'Dowd flicks it away for one.
Roelof van der Merwe comes out to bat.
Length ball, on off. Heaved down to long on for a couple.

OUT! TAKEN! That took ages to come! Shorter and slower outside off. Stephan Myburgh goes for the cut but gets the top edge. The ball goes high in the air to point and Stephan Baard takes it with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Stephan Baard b Jan Frylinck

Commentary.Commentary: A touch fuller, on leg. Heaved to deep square leg for one.
Length ball, around off. Max O'Dowd comes down the track to heave it but misses.
On a length, on off. Pushed to covers. The fielder dives and stops the ball.
Length ball, down the leg side. Stephan Myburgh misses the pull. Wide called.
Length ball, on middle. Stephan Myburgh pushes it to mid on and scampers through for a run.
Wide! Length ball, angling in from middle. Stephan Myburgh shuffles across and looks to whip it but he misses and the ball goes just past the leg stump. Wided!
FOUR! Nicely done! Length ball, on middle and leg. Stephan Myburgh makes room on the off side and smashes it past covers for a boundary.
Length ball, jagging back in from middle. Max O'Dowd looks to heave it away across the line but it goes off the thick inside edge towards short fine leg. The batters cross for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Max O'Dowd drives but finds the cover fielder.
Good-length ball, around off. Max O'Dowd blocks it off the front foot.
Full ball, outside off. Max O'Dowd lofts it over extra cover and collects a couple of runs.
Excellent running! Back of a length, on middle. Max O'Dowd pulls it behind square on the leg side. The fielder in the deep fumbles and the batters take three.
Length ball, around leg. Stephan Myburgh drags it to mid-wicket and takes a run.

In the air, but just out of the reach! Short of a length, outside off. Stephan Myburgh looks to pull but it goes off the toe end and the ball goes just over the mid-wicket fielder who jumps to catch it. The ball takes his fingertips and rolls behind. Two taken!
Good-length ball, on off. Stephan Myburgh looks to cut hard but he gets the inner half of the bat and the ball goes to cover.
Back of a length, outside off. Stephan Myburgh pushes it to cover off the back foot.
Good-length ball, down leg. Stephan Myburgh misses his flick and gets hit high on his pads.
Change. Jan Frylinck comes in the attack.
Short of a length, on off. Max O'Dowd blocks it off the back foot.
Full ball, outside off. Max O'Dowd drives hard but finds the mid off fielder.
FOUR! Good use of the feet! Length ball, around off. Max O'Dowd advances down and lofts it over mid off for a boundary now.
SIX! BANG! Short ball, down leg. Max O'Dowd rocks back and pulls it over deep square leg for a maximum!
Back of a length, just outside off. Max O'Dowd stays back and pushes it to backward point.
Length ball, on off. Max O'Dowd blocks it towards cover-point.
Change. Ruben Trumpelmann comes on now.
Well bowled! Good-length ball, shaping away, around off. Stephan Myburgh looks to defend but the ball zips past his outside edge.
Back of a length, outside off. Max O'Dowd cuts it past point for a single.
FOUR! Wiese spills it down leg. Max O'Dowd tickles it to the vacant fine leg region and collects a boundary.
Length ball, around off. Max O'Dowd defends it off the front foot.
Good-length ball, on middle. Stephan Myburgh looks to cut but it takes the inner half of the bat towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Punished by Stephan Myburgh! Short ball, down leg. Myburgh works it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Who will start from the other end? David Wiese it is.
Floated, around off. Stephan Myburgh drills it to long on for one.
Tossed up, on middle. Stephan Myburgh whips it off his pads towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
A tad short, around off. Stephan Myburgh looks to cut but is beaten.
Tossed up, around off. Stephan Myburgh blocks it out off the front foot.
Netherlands are underway! Quicker ball, around leg. Max O'Dowd flicks it to square leg and collects a single.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Max O'Dowd misses his heave and gets hit on the pads.

We are set for the action. The players walk out for the national anthems. First, the national of Netherlands is played, followed by the one of Namibia. The anthems are done and the players have taken the field. Stephan Myburgh and Max O'Dowd walk out to bat. Bernard Scholtz is set to start with the ball.

Russel Arnold is down for the pitch report. He says that the pitch is nice and hard. Adds that 155 would be the par score on this wicket. Ian Bishop says that when Sri Lanka played here, their spinners targeted the stumps and maybe that is the way to go on this pitch.

Pieter Seelaar, the skipper of Netherlands, says that they would have bowled first. Adds that they want to concentrate on the game on hand and not think too much about the last game. Informs that there are two changes.

Gerhard Erasmus, the skipper of Namibia, says they will bowl first and they are looking to put pressure on the opposition. Adds that they came up against a strong side in Sri Lanka in their first game and they would like to correct those things in the middle. Signs off by saying that they have made one change to their side going into this match.

Namibia (Playing XI) - Stephan Baard, Zane Green (WK), Craig Williams, Gerhard Erasmus (C), David Wiese, JJ Smit, Jan Frylinck, Michael Van Lingen (In for Pikky Ya France), Nicol Loftie-Eaton, Ruben Trumpelmann, Bernard Scholtz.

Netherlands (Playing XI) - Max O'Dowd, Stephan Myburgh (In for Ben Cooper), Bas de Leede, Colin Ackermann, Ryan ten Doeschate, Scott Edwards (WK), Roelof van der Merwe, Pieter Seelaar (C), Logan van Beek, Timm van der Gugten (In for Brandon Glover), Fred Klaassen.
TOSS - Both the skippers are out in the middle. Up goes the coin and it lands in favor of Namibia. They will bowl first.

Netherlands, on the other hand, have a decent side but they were handed a comprehensive defeat in their first game against Ireland. They have some experienced players in the form of Ryan ten Doeschate and Roelof van der Merwe who need to step up in this all-important fixture if they are to stay in the race for Super 12. The men in orange would be looking to bounce back after a disappointing loss against Ireland and not to forget that they would also be keen to win this match comprehensively to better their net run rate. Who will come out victorious in this must-win encounter? We shall find that soon. Stay tuned for toss and further updates.

Namibia were blown away by Sri Lanka in the first game and they will certainly need to pull their socks up heading into this game as they cannot afford to lose one more game. They suffered a heavy defeat in their opening game and it certainly did not help their net run rate either. Gerhard Erasmus and his men would be eager to comeback strong and put on a better show against Netherlands.

Hello and a very warm welcome to game number 7 of group A where Namibia will face Netherlands. It is a critical game for both these teams in order to stay in the race for Super 12 stage as both Namibia and Netherlands lost their opening encounter.
